# Joel Cook

> Joel Cook is an AI architect at Indian River State College, a public college in Florida. Joel builds the software a public college would usually rent, with personal data kept out of the AI models: an AI student advisor, a document classifier that moved 946,091 records from Workday into Banner without a $600,000 consultant, and the college's main website, which serves about 250,000 visitors a month.

Joel's AI work follows a few rules: answers come from official sources, quoted and linked; models get read-only access to systems of record and never hold the keys; logs record outcomes, not what people type; personal information is caught in the browser before anything is sent; and a test set gates every prompt, tool, or model change.

Earlier, Joel shipped Ballad Health's HIPAA-compliant patient app on Epic's MyChart SDK (rated 4.6 stars on the App Store), built the real-time stats and broadcast graphics software behind FloSports, launched Orlando City SC's official LionNation app, and built and ran AWS infrastructure for Stellantis launch sites with Iconix Inc.

## Work

- [AI Architect, Indian River State College](https://www.irsc.edu/) (2025–present): Built the college's main website and AI advisor, and cut over $600k in vendor costs.
- [Independent software engineer, with Iconix Inc.](https://www.iconixinc.com/work.php) (2023–present): Engineered launch sites and AWS infrastructure (Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, load balancing, databases, S3, Auth0) for Jeep, Ram, Dodge, and Fiat.
- [Software Engineer, Modea](https://www.modea.com/) (2022–2024): Shipped Ballad Health's HIPAA-compliant patient app on Epic's MyChart SDK for iOS and Android.
- [Software Engineer, FloSports](https://www.flosports.tv/) (2019–2022): Built real-time stats and broadcast graphics software reaching millions of sports fans.
- [Mobile Application Developer, FanHero](https://fanhero.com/) (2018–2019): Launched Orlando City SC's official LionNation app to 15k+ downloads.

## Projects

- [RiverGuide](https://chat.riverboard.org): The college's AI advisor. It searches about 2,400 official college pages, links every answer to its source, blocks personal information in the browser, runs on a local model, and is gated by a 54-question test set. The rebuild is written up in [RiverGuide 2 searches the college’s own 2,389 pages](https://joelcook.github.io/blog/search-the-site-dont-copy-it/). Its search model, trained in-house, is written up in [Search: 48% more accurate, 26% faster, 29% cheaper](https://joelcook.github.io/blog/embeddings-lost-so-i-trained-one/). Version one handled 9,000+ student chats a week and cost $47,000 a year less than the vendor bot it replaced.
- [Workday-to-Banner classifier](https://joelcook.github.io/blog/six-hundred-thousand-dollars-and-a-document-classifier/): Moved 946,091 document records into Banner with names and IDs masked before matching, uncertain records sent to an approved fallback, and every reviewer change audited.
- [irsc.edu](https://www.irsc.edu/): The college's main website, built from scratch on WordPress and PHP with custom plugins for emergency alerts, events, the course catalog, and AI-converted accessible PDFs. Hosting costs were cut by 84%.
- [RiverBoard](https://riverboard.org): A dependency-free team task board with Claude connected over MCP.
- [Bento](https://github.com/joelcook/bento): A small native text editor in C, with a raylib GUI and a terminal build.
